said: DeepSeek will look into this one.

`next_meeting` calls `min()` over the meetings (clubnotes/schedule.py:47), so with an empty schedule it raises `ValueError: min() arg is an empty sequence`. Nothing checks for that today; returning `None` or raising a clearer error would be the fix.
